challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: I need the loyalty basket model deployed before the leaflet print run locks. The promotion deadline is immovable, and every hour of delay pushes the allocation error closer to a stockout on the first morning. I am happy to insert a manual approval gate into the pipeline if that keeps the legal team comfortable. I just need that gate to be a single click, not a full audit review. The faster we get the model live, the better the residual stock numbers will look for the middle aisle. I am not asking to skip the check, but I am asking for the check to be quick enough to keep the pipeline moving without stalling the entire release train.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that the faster the model is deployed, the better the outcome will be, indicating that exceeding the minimum speed requirement would increase their satisfaction.
